description: Synopsys is ready to divest an Ansys unit and one of its own to secure EU approval for its $35 billion acquisition. The company has offered to sell Ansys PowerArtist and its Optical Solutions Group to address antitrust concerns.

title: Keysight's Spirent Acquisition And Cyclical Recovery To Drive 12% EPS Growth In FY25; JP Morgan Upgrades Stock
description: JP Morgan upgraded Keysight Technologies to Overweight, citing expectations of broadening demand drivers and a cyclical recovery in end-markets through 2025. The analyst expects the Spirent acquisition to enhance Keysight's leverage in cyclical markets and improve margins through operational synergies.
